lessons.title: Strategy for hypothesis
lessons.vector_text: science_rd. hypothesis. Define the target and constraints; use evidence appropriate to the claim; test failure cases; distinguish verified results from assumptions; calibrate the final claim.
lessons.strategy_summary: State the observation, proposed mechanism and discriminating prediction; list plausible alternatives and what evidence would separate them.
lessons.failure_or_counterexample_test: Construct an alternative mechanism that explains the same observation and identify a discriminating test.

lessons.title: Strategy for experiment design
lessons.vector_text: science_rd. experiment_design. Define the target and constraints; use evidence appropriate to the claim; test failure cases; distinguish verified results from assumptions; calibrate the final claim.
lessons.strategy_summary: Define hypothesis, primary endpoint, controls, confounders, measurement uncertainty and stopping/analysis plan before observing outcomes.
lessons.failure_or_counterexample_test: Check whether controls and measurements can distinguish the target effect from major confounders.

lessons.title: Strategy for literature synthesis
lessons.vector_text: science_rd. literature_synthesis. Define the target and constraints; use evidence appropriate to the claim; test failure cases; distinguish verified results from assumptions; calibrate the final claim.
lessons.strategy_summary: Define question and inclusion scope; prioritize primary evidence; normalize populations, methods and dates; map agreement, conflicts and uncertainty.
lessons.failure_or_counterexample_test: Remove the most influential source and test whether the synthesis materially changes.

lessons.title: Strategy for model comparison
lessons.vector_text: science_rd. model_comparison. Define the target and constraints; use evidence appropriate to the claim; test failure cases; distinguish verified results from assumptions; calibrate the final claim.
lessons.strategy_summary: Specify competing models, shared data, likelihood or scoring rule, complexity assumptions and out-of-sample test; compare predictions rather than narratives.
lessons.failure_or_counterexample_test: Evaluate models on the same held-out observations and report uncertainty.

lessons.title: Strategy for falsification
lessons.vector_text: science_rd. falsification. Define the target and constraints; use evidence appropriate to the claim; test failure cases; distinguish verified results from assumptions; calibrate the final claim.
lessons.strategy_summary: Translate the claim into observable consequences and define outcomes that would count against it; seek high-information tests rather than confirmations.
lessons.failure_or_counterexample_test: Precommit at least one result that would weaken or reject the claim.

lessons.title: Strategy for fact retrieval
lessons.vector_text: research_evidence. fact_retrieval. Define the target and constraints; use evidence appropriate to the claim; test failure cases; distinguish verified results from assumptions; calibrate the final claim.
lessons.strategy_summary: Resolve entity, date, jurisdiction and requested fact; prefer authoritative or primary sources; preserve exact scope and freshness.
anti_patterns: answering a current fact from stale memory
lessons.failure_or_counterexample_test: Cross-check the fact against a second suitable source or explicitly report single-source status.

lessons.title: Strategy for source comparison
lessons.vector_text: research_evidence. source_comparison. Define the target and constraints; use evidence appropriate to the claim; test failure cases; distinguish verified results from assumptions; calibrate the final claim.
lessons.strategy_summary: Compare sources on claim, date, population, definitions, methodology and evidence chain; explain conflicts without averaging incompatible statements.
lessons.failure_or_counterexample_test: Trace each conflicting claim to its underlying evidence and definitions.

lessons.title: Strategy for provenance
lessons.vector_text: research_evidence. provenance. Define the target and constraints; use evidence appropriate to the claim; test failure cases; distinguish verified results from assumptions; calibrate the final claim.
lessons.strategy_summary: Record source identity, retrieval date, transformation steps and evidence-to-claim mapping; keep inference distinct from quoted or measured facts.
lessons.failure_or_counterexample_test: Attempt to reconstruct every material claim from its recorded provenance.

lessons.title: Strategy for uncertainty
lessons.vector_text: research_evidence. uncertainty. Define the target and constraints; use evidence appropriate to the claim; test failure cases; distinguish verified results from assumptions; calibrate the final claim.
lessons.strategy_summary: Separate measurement error, sampling uncertainty, model uncertainty and unknown unknowns; report intervals or scenarios appropriate to evidence.
anti_patterns: single confidence number hiding different uncertainties
lessons.failure_or_counterexample_test: Perturb dominant uncertainty sources and test conclusion stability.

lessons.title: Strategy for synthesis
lessons.vector_text: research_evidence. synthesis. Define the target and constraints; use evidence appropriate to the claim; test failure cases; distinguish verified results from assumptions; calibrate the final claim.
lessons.strategy_summary: Decompose the question, collect evidence by subclaim, deduplicate shared sources, reconcile compatible results and preserve unresolved contradictions.
lessons.failure_or_counterexample_test: Build the synthesis after removing duplicate/dependent evidence and verify contradictions remain visible.
